purpose: First-time user smoke through documented public README commands
automatic_dispatch: On every hourly check, assign an authorized next task to each verified idle host; avoid duplicate active jobs
steps: Freeze clean source identity and record system prerequisites
Generate or copy a committed public example configuration; fill independent model/API roles and declared tiny budget
Run public --plan and --check-only; record preparation separately
Run the public experiment command without private adaptation
Verify saved result, native target/Worker trajectories and benchmark scoring; preserve failures and usage
allowed_orchestration: Collect original evidence and merge reports
forbidden_acceptance_dependencies: Changing algorithm/gates/tasks/grading or model replies to obtain a pass
Private product patches required because the public native integration cannot run in a standard infrastructure-complete environment
Claiming a custom configuration or cached/local data test proves a different default/automatic-download mode
infrastructure: Dependency installation, official image/data caches, VPN/proxy and platform Docker connectivity may be prepared externally and documented. Do not modify product algorithms, harness semantics, tasks or graders to compensate for infrastructure.
existing_evidence: Retain valid prior integration passes. Cold-cache first-user experience is supplementary coverage, not a prerequisite for retaining all earlier passed cells.
legal_noop: A valid no-update/tie/skip outcome can pass the runnable-flow criterion; unexercised branches remain separately reported
required_evidence: public configuration source and redacted saved config
dependency/data preparation and cold/warm cache distinction
product_failures: Record original public-path failure and minimal reproduction; do not add silent smoke-specific adaptation
inflight_jobs: Preserve current paid executions and evidence; restore remaining original unique queues after their ownership is released. No duplicate paid runs.
user_clarification: Original requirement: the repository must run through public configuration and the native integration in an infrastructure-complete environment. Prior valid integration smoke remains valid; environment preparation is acceptable and does not require wholesale revalidation.
